description: This file contains decorators and classes for registering, scheduling, and executing tasks within the Global Task Framework (GTF) in the Superset project. It defines a 'task' decorator, a 'TaskWrapper' class for managing task execution (sync and async), and handles task submission, validation, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: TaskWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for task functions that provides methods for scheduling and executing tasks synchronously or asynchronously, managing task state transitions, and handling task lifecycle events.

methods.name: task
methods.description: A decorator function to register a function as a task with optional configuration such as name, scope, and timeout.

methods.name: TaskWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TaskWrapper instance, setting up function, scope, default options, and signature for introspection.

methods.name: TaskWrapper._merge_options
methods.description: Merges default task options with call-time overrides, giving precedence to call-time options.

methods.name: TaskWrapper._validate_task
methods.description: Validates task configuration, especially for shared tasks requiring a task_key.

methods.name: TaskWrapper.__call__
methods.description: Executes the task synchronously, handling task submission, deduplication, and inline execution with state management.

methods.name: TaskWrapper._wait_for_existing_task
methods.description: Waits for an existing task to complete, with optional timeout, and returns the final task state.

methods.name: TaskWrapper._execute_inline
methods.description: Executes the task function inline, managing status transitions, timeout, and error handling.

methods.name: TaskWrapper.schedule
methods.description: Schedules the task for asynchronous execution, returning a pending Task object.
